overall: The AG found no violation in entering executive session for litigation strategy, but found the chair failed to state the purpose with enough detail and the executive session minutes were incomplete; ordered compliance and minute amendment.

allegations.summary: Chair allegedly failed to state a sufficient purpose for an August 31, 2011 executive session on litigation before the Commission went into it.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Commission failed to provide sufficient detail in stating the purpose for its August 31, 2011 executive session.

allegations.summary: Commission allegedly failed to follow the required procedures for entering executive session on August 31, 2011.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Commission followed the proper procedures in convening an executive session on August 31, 2011.

allegations.summary: Commission allegedly failed to establish that an open meeting would have a detrimental effect on its litigating position.
allegations.key_passage: We believe that the Commission was justified in meeting in executive session to protect its litigation position.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged no minutes were available for the August 31, 2011 meeting; the executive session minutes were withheld.
allegations.key_passage: The executive session minutes continue to be withheld from the public because the purpose for the executive session has not yet expired.

allegations.summary: Executive session minutes for August 31, 2011 allegedly lacked the required detail of discussion.
allegations.key_passage: We also find that the minutes of the Commission's August 31, 2011 executive session are incomplete.

allegations.summary: Allegation that the meeting notice failed to list topics the chair reasonably anticipated was raised first with the AG, not the Commission.
allegations.key_passage: It does not appear that this allegation was filed with the Commission prior to being raised with our office.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Amend the August 31, 2011 executive session minutes to include a summary of the Commission's discussion within thirty (30) days of receipt of the letter.
remedy_passage: We order the Commission's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and further order the Commission to amend its August 31, 2011 executive session minutes to include a summary of the Commissions discussion.
